summary: xAI released v1.18.0 of its Python SDK, adding an 'xhigh' reasoning_effort option and adding grok-4.6 to the ChatModel enum.

practices.reason: Teams using the xai-sdk-python must update to this version to reference the grok-4.6 model or use the new xhigh reasoning_effort parameter.
practices.quote: Accept xhigh reasoning_effort and add grok-4.6 to ChatModel
